wild_vern_realbook_70s_felt_tip.name: wild_vern_realbook_70s_felt_tip
wild_vern_realbook_70s_felt_tip.description: 1970s underground Berklee Real Book lead-sheet hand in thick chisel felt-tip marker with bold chevron-wedge noteheads, wide horizontal beams, and stylized lightning-Z rests.
wild_vern_realbook_70s_felt_tip.paleography_notes: Rooted in the 1974-1975 Berklee underground Real Book and Boston jazz-copyist vernacular (Steve Swallow / Paul Bley / Pat Metheny circle). Drawn with a broad chisel felt-tip marker held at a steep 52 deg angle on warm comb-bound photocopy stock, yielding bold chevron-wedge noteheads, heavy flat beaming, minimal clefs, and trademark lightning-Z and tall-Z quarter rests.

wild_vern_bebop_parker_napkin_ballpoint.name: wild_vern_bebop_parker_napkin_ballpoint
wild_vern_bebop_parker_napkin_ballpoint.description: Frantic 1940s-50s 52nd Street bebop head jotted on a nightclub napkin in leaky blue-black ballpoint with slim open-loop noteheads, heavy feathering, and wild scribble rests.
wild_vern_bebop_parker_napkin_ballpoint.paleography_notes: Evokes rapid backstage and bar-table bebop contrafact sketches (Charlie Parker / Dizzy Gillespie / Bud Powell era on 52nd Street and Minton's Playhouse). Written at breakneck tempo with an early oil-paste ballpoint pen on porous paper napkin stock: unclosed slim open-loop noteheads, severe ink feathering and ring stains, crooked hand-ruled staves, and urgent slash-zig and scribble-S rests.

wild_vern_ellington_strayhorn_arranger_s.name: wild_vern_ellington_strayhorn_arranger_slash
wild_vern_ellington_strayhorn_arranger_s.description: Sweeping 1940s Duke Ellington / Billy Strayhorn big-band arranger score hand with razor-thin forward-slanted needle-slash noteheads and dramatic cursive momentum.
wild_vern_ellington_strayhorn_arranger_s.paleography_notes: Inspired by Billy Strayhorn and Duke Ellington's touring-train and hotel-room score manuscripts in the Smithsonian Ellington Archives. Characterized by an exuberant 16.5 deg forward slant, ultra-slim needle-slash noteheads flicked across 12-staff cream score paper in dark sepia-black ink, tall sweeping stems, and energetic hurried-slash and modern-tall-Z rests.

wild_vern_bluenote_hardbop_pencil.name: wild_vern_bluenote_hardbop_pencil
wild_vern_bluenote_hardbop_pencil.description: 1950s-60s Blue Note hard-bop studio lead-sheet in soft 2B graphite pencil with slim diamond noteheads, smoky paper tooth, and heavy rehearsal smudges.
wild_vern_bluenote_hardbop_pencil.paleography_notes: Modeled on Rudy Van Gelder studio-rehearsal lead sheets (Wayne Shorter, Horace Silver, Lee Morgan, Joe Henderson). Soft 2B wooden graphite on buff 10-staff pads produces grainy tonal strokes, crisp slim-diamond noteheads angled for rapid sight-reading, frequent chord-change eraser smudges, and sharp-V-tick and lightning-Z rests.

wild_vern_gil_evans_airy_pencil.name: wild_vern_gil_evans_airy_pencil
wild_vern_gil_evans_airy_pencil.description: Gil Evans ultra-slim, airy orchestral-jazz pencil score on translucent blue-tinted vellum with razor-thin hairline-dash noteheads and vast open blank staves.
wild_vern_gil_evans_airy_pencil.paleography_notes: Inspired by Gil Evans' luminous, whisper-light orchestral jazz sketches (Miles Ahead, Porgy and Bess, Sketches of Spain). Drafted with a sharply pointed hard HB/2H draftsman's pencil on pale blue-grey diazo vellum: ultra-slim hairline-dash noteheads (aspect 0.28), low fill density, delicate poised stroke weight, generous blank tacet staves, and architectural modern-tall-Z rests.

wild_vern_nashville_session_quick_chart.name: wild_vern_nashville_session_quick_chart
wild_vern_nashville_session_quick_chart.description: Nashville Music Row studio-session quick chart in dark navy rollerball on yellow-cream spiral pad with flicked boomerang-hook noteheads and decisive sharp-V rests.
wild_vern_nashville_session_quick_chart.paleography_notes: Reflects Nashville Music Row A-Team studio session charting (where rhythm and melody cues are sketched in minutes during a single demo playback). Written in fast liquid navy-black rollerball on yellow-tinted spiral-bound pad paper with brisk boomerang-hook noteheads, overshooting barlines dividing 4-bar phrases, sharp-V-tick rests, and dense roadmap margin annotations.

wild_vern_tin_pan_alley_plugger_fountain.name: wild_vern_tin_pan_alley_plugger_fountain
wild_vern_tin_pan_alley_plugger_fountain.description: 1920s New York Tin Pan Alley song-plugger fountain-pen fair lead in warm sepia-black ink with broad-nib lozenge heads and theatrical calligraphic S-curl rests.
wild_vern_tin_pan_alley_plugger_fountain.paleography_notes: Modeled on 1910s-1930s West 28th Street / Brill Building song-plugger piano-vocal demonstration manuscripts (Irving Berlin, George Gershwin, Jerome Kern publishing-house copyists). Written with a flexible gold-nibbed lever-filler fountain pen in warm sepia-black ink on rag manuscript paper: crisp broad-nib-lozenge heads, strong thick-thin contrast, occasional split-nib hairlines, and graceful calligraphic-S-curl rests.

wild_vern_brazilian_choro_samba_slim.name: wild_vern_brazilian_choro_samba_slim
wild_vern_brazilian_choro_samba_slim.description: Rio de Janeiro roda-de-choro caderno manuscript in royal-blue fine ballpoint with ultra-slim oval noteheads, fluid forward slant, and dense sixteenth-note runs.
wild_vern_brazilian_choro_samba_slim.paleography_notes: Grounded in the Rio de Janeiro roda-de-choro caderno de partituras tradition (Pixinguinha, Jacob do Bandolim, Altamiro Carrilho repertoire notebooks). Penned briskly in classic Brazilian Bic royal-blue ink on spiral-bound caderno de musica paper: ultra-slim oval noteheads (aspect 0.38) that pack dense syncopated sixteenth-note passages cleanly, buoyant 13.5 deg forward lean, and cursive-3 rests.

wild_vern_argentine_tango_bandoneon.name: wild_vern_argentine_tango_bandoneon
wild_vern_argentine_tango_bandoneon.description: 1940s Buenos Aires Golden-Age tango cafe bandoneon part in deep iron-black dip ink with sharp slim-diamond noteheads, espresso-ring stains, and ornate Baroque-style rests.
wild_vern_argentine_tango_bandoneon.paleography_notes: Based on Golden-Age Buenos Aires orquesta tipica bandoneon parts (Anibal Troilo, Osvaldo Pugliese, Astor Piazzolla arr. folders) copied in black dip/fountain ink on worn cafe-stained rag stock. Features crisp angled slim-diamond noteheads, expressive nib contrast, occasional split-nib hairlines on sweeping slurs, espresso-ring stain artifacts, and Old-World ornate clefs with baroque-flag-loop and calligraphic-S rests.

wild_vern_klezmer_balkan_fiddler_ink.name: wild_vern_klezmer_balkan_fiddler_ink
wild_vern_klezmer_balkan_fiddler_ink.description: Early-20th-century Eastern European klezmer/Balkan wedding fiddler's cramped notebook in pooling iron-brown dip ink with heavy ink-blot noteheads, split nibs, and hand-ruled crooked staves.
wild_vern_klezmer_balkan_fiddler_ink.paleography_notes: Modeled on Beregovski-era Ukrainian/Bessarabian klezmer and Balkan lautari repertoire notebooks kept in coat pockets for multi-day weddings. Written with a tired steel dip nib in dark iron-brown ink on rough rag paper: pooling ink-blot noteheads, frequent split-nib double tracks, severe end-of-bar cramming, hand-ruled wavy staves (high rastrum_wobble), and archaic baroque-C-hook and scribble-S rests.

wild_vern_irish_scottish_fiddle_hairline.name: wild_vern_irish_scottish_fiddle_hairline
wild_vern_irish_scottish_fiddle_hairline.description: 19th-century Irish/Scottish fiddle tune-book in faded peat-brown crowquill ink with razor-thin vertical-tick noteheads, fine ornamentation, and archaic backwards-7 rests.
wild_vern_irish_scottish_fiddle_hairline.paleography_notes: Inspired by 18th-19th century Highland and Irish vernacular fiddle tune-books (O'Neill, Goodman, Patrick McDonald, and parish piper/fiddler commonplace books). Penned with a sharp crowquill or finely sharpened pencil in faded peat-brown iron-gall ink: ultra-thin vertical-tick noteheads (aspect 0.30, scale 0.72), delicate stroke width, hand-ruled staves, and traditional backwards-7-hook and baroque-C rests.

wild_vern_appalachian_shapenote_fiddle.name: wild_vern_appalachian_shapenote_fiddle
wild_vern_appalachian_shapenote_fiddle.description: Rural Appalachian shape-note / old-time fiddle ledger in walnut-brown stub ink with wide broad-nib lozenge noteheads, upright-backslant hand, and rugged hand-drawn staves.
wild_vern_appalachian_shapenote_fiddle.paleography_notes: Evokes 19th-century Southern Harmony / Sacred Harp singing-school copybooks and Appalachian fiddle tune ledgers. Written with a blunt stub nib in homemade walnut-gall brown ink on coarse ledger stock: distinctly wide geometric broad-nib-lozenge noteheads (aspect 1.46) echoing fasola diamond/triangle traditions, slight backward slant, heavy hand-ruled rastrum wobble, and sturdy backwards-7 and sharp-V rests.

wild_vern_flamenco_guitar_sketch.name: wild_vern_flamenco_guitar_sketch
wild_vern_flamenco_guitar_sketch.description: Andalusian flamenco falseta melody sketch in deep burgundy-black ink with extreme forward-leaning needle-slash noteheads and tempestuous overshooting barlines.
wild_vern_flamenco_guitar_sketch.paleography_notes: Captures rapid Andalusian guitar falseta and compas transcriptions jotted down between tablao sets in Seville or Jerez. Written with a fast slanted fountain or roller pen in dark burgundy-black ink on warm cream manuscript sheets: extreme 17.5 deg forward slant, razor-thin needle-slash noteheads (aspect 0.32), sweeping barline overshoots marking 12-beat compas accents, and urgent hurried-slash and scribble-S rests.

wild_vern_mariachi_trumpet_marker.name: wild_vern_mariachi_trumpet_marker
wild_vern_mariachi_trumpet_marker.description: Guadalajara mariachi trumpet-section chart written in heavy black chisel Sharpie on bright white card with huge wide chevron-wedge noteheads built for outdoor plaza sight-reading.
wild_vern_mariachi_trumpet_marker.paleography_notes: Grounded in Mexican mariachi trumpet and vihuela section charts written for dim cantinas and sunny outdoor plazas (Plaza Garibaldi / Jalisco traditions). Drawn with a thick permanent chisel marker on bright white heavyweight stock: massive wide chevron-wedge noteheads (scale 1.38, aspect 1.62, density 1.42), ultra-bold strokes (stroke_scale 1.88), noticeable marker bleed-through and feathering, and unmistakable lightning-Z rests.

wild_vern_gospel_choir_rehearsal_jot.name: wild_vern_gospel_choir_rehearsal_jot
wild_vern_gospel_choir_rehearsal_jot.description: Expressive gospel choir director's rehearsal quick-jot in rich plum-violet felt pen with scrubbed zigzag-fill noteheads, heavy vocal-part margin cues, and lively cursive rests.
wild_vern_gospel_choir_rehearsal_jot.paleography_notes: Reflects Black church gospel choir rehearsal lead sheets and vamp-cue reductions jotted rapidly by a choir director or Hammond organist during rehearsal. Written in vivid deep plum-purple felt-tip pen on bright white photocopy manuscript paper: energetic zigzag-fill noteheads scribbled rapidly inside the oval, abundant rehearsal callouts in the margins (0.88), and expressive cursive-3 and hurried-slash rests.

wild_vern_indie_rock_spiral_gelpen.name: wild_vern_indie_rock_spiral_gelpen
wild_vern_indie_rock_spiral_gelpen.description: Indie/rock songwriter's spiral-notebook gel-pen sketch in dark teal-indigo ink with quirky left-leaning open-loop noteheads, minimal fill, and casual scribble rests.
wild_vern_indie_rock_spiral_gelpen.paleography_notes: Captures bedroom-studio and tour-van indie/alternative songwriter melody sketches in a 0.5mm Muji/Pilot teal-indigo gel pen on college-ruled spiral manuscript pad paper. Uniform ball-tip stroke (nib_min_ratio 0.93), quirky -7.5 deg backward lean, airy unfilled open-loop noteheads (fill_density 0.36, hollow_open_prob 0.72), minimal clefs, and casual scribble-S and sharp-V-tick rests.

wild_vern_musical_theater_rehearsal_penc.name: wild_vern_musical_theater_rehearsal_pencil
wild_vern_musical_theater_rehearsal_penc.description: Broadway musical-theater rehearsal pianist's Blackwing 602 graphite hand with slim boomerang-hook noteheads, heavy revision eraser smudges, and dense cut/vamp cues.
wild_vern_musical_theater_rehearsal_penc.paleography_notes: Modeled on New York musical-theater rehearsal-room piano-conductor reductions constantly rewritten during previews and tech week. Drawn with a soft Palomino Blackwing 602 pencil on cream 12-staff paper: intense graphite grain (0.52), pervasive eraser smudges from daily cuts and key transpositions (0.82), brisk slim boomerang-hook noteheads (aspect 0.44), and wall-to-wall margin annotations (0.92).

wild_vern_street_busker_pocket_scribble.name: wild_vern_street_busker_pocket_scribble
wild_vern_street_busker_pocket_scribble.description: Weathered street-busker's pocket-pad scribble in skipping faded blue ballpoint with tiny pinprick-dot noteheads, extreme wobble, rain/coffee stains, and cramped endings.
wild_vern_street_busker_pocket_scribble.paleography_notes: Inspired by subway and sidewalk buskers' dog-eared pocket notebooks carried in instrument cases. Written on the knee with a battered cheap blue ballpoint pen that skips and blobs: tiny pinprick-dot noteheads (scale 0.56, aspect 0.36), heavy hand wobble and tremor, severe end-bar cramming, crooked hand-drawn staves, and heavy rain/coffee stains (0.66).

wild_vern_marching_lyre_tiny_card.name: wild_vern_marching_lyre_tiny_card
wild_vern_marching_lyre_tiny_card.description: Brass-band marching-lyre flip-folder card in crisp 0.25mm technical pen with microscopic pinprick-dot noteheads, tight disciplined spacing, and compact sharp-V rests.
wild_vern_marching_lyre_tiny_card.paleography_notes: Modeled on New Orleans brass-band, British brass, and collegiate marching-band flip-folder lyre cards (5x7 inch pocket cards clipped to a horn). Drafted with a 0.25mm waterproof technical pen on bright white card stock to fit an entire march onto one tiny card: microscopic dense pinprick-dot noteheads (scale 0.52, aspect 0.50), ultra-steady hand (wobble 0.46), strong end-of-bar packing, and compact sharp-V-tick rests.

wild_vern_blues_horn_thick_slash.name: wild_vern_blues_horn_thick_slash
wild_vern_blues_horn_thick_slash.description: Chicago/Memphis blues horn-section head chart in juicy broad felt marker with heavy wide ink-blot noteheads, pooling ink, and club-stage coffee stains.
wild_vern_blues_horn_thick_slash.paleography_notes: Grounded in 1960s Memphis (Stax/Hi Records) and Chicago blues horn-section punch charts shared across music stands in dark clubs. Written with a saturated wide chisel felt marker on buff manuscript sheets: oversized wide ink-blot noteheads (scale 1.32, aspect 1.74, density 1.46), heavy ink pooling and paper feathering, club drink-ring stains, and slashing hurried-zig and lightning-Z rests.

wild_vern_afrobeat_funk_horn_bold.name: wild_vern_afrobeat_funk_horn_bold
wild_vern_afrobeat_funk_horn_bold.description: 1970s Lagos Afrobeat / James Brown funk horn-chart in bold deep-navy chisel marker on green-tinted studio mimeo paper with wide zigzag-fill noteheads and punchy syncopation.
wild_vern_afrobeat_funk_horn_bold.paleography_notes: Inspired by 1970s Lagos Africa 70 / JB's horn-section ostinato charts written for high-energy live horn lines and studio lock-ins. Drafted with a punchy wide chisel marker in deep indigo-black ink on vintage green-tinted studio stock: wide scrubbed zigzag-fill noteheads (scale 1.28, aspect 1.54), emphatic overshooting barlines marking groove cycles, and bold modern-tall-Z and lightning-Z rests.

wild_vern_scandinavian_fiddle_tidy_slim.name: wild_vern_scandinavian_fiddle_tidy_slim
wild_vern_scandinavian_fiddle_tidy_slim.description: Swedish/Norwegian spelmanslag folk-fiddle fair copy in cool slate-blue-black archival pen with tidy ultra-slim oval noteheads, crisp low wobble, and graceful Baroque-flag rests.
wild_vern_scandinavian_fiddle_tidy_slim.paleography_notes: Modeled on Swedish Svenska Latar and Norwegian Hardingfele/spelman archival transcription notebooks maintained by meticulous Nordic folk collectors and spelmanslag leaders. Written with a fine steel fountain or archival pen in cool slate-blue-black ink on crisp bright-white manuscript stock: ultra-slim tidy oval noteheads (aspect 0.34, scale 0.80), minimal wobble (0.44), poised ornate clefs, and clean modern-tall-Z and baroque-flag-loop rests.
